data.long_meaning: Rashi is a Sanskrit name that means ‘jewel’, ‘precious one’, or ‘radiant’. It is also associated with the night sky and the constellations. In Hindu astrology, Rashi refers to the zodiac sign under which a person is born. The name evokes a sense of beauty, value, and mystery. The name Rashi carries the meaning “Jewel, precious one, radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rashi usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious one, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rashi is a divine name that represents the inner light and radiance of the soul. It is believed to bring good fortune, happiness, and success to those who bear it. Rashi is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and abundance.
data.etymology: Rashi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, precious one, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rashi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
